parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Obtain $3\sin x+4\cos x$. B1. State $R=5$. B1 FT their 3 and 4. Use a trigonometric formula to find $\alpha$, e.g. $\alpha=\tan^{-1}(\frac34)$. M1 using their 3 and 4. If $\cos\alpha=4$ and $\sin\alpha=3$ are seen, this scores M0 A0. Obtain $\alpha=36.9°$ or AWRT $36.9°$. A1. Total: [4]

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Evaluate $\cos^{-1}(-\frac4R)$. B1 FT their $R$ from part (a). Allow $\cos^{-1}(-\frac45)$ for B1, giving $143.13\ldots$. Carry out a correct method to find a value of $\theta$ in the given interval. M1. Obtain an answer, e.g. $60(.0)°$. A1; answers may be more accurate; accept AWRT $60.0$. Obtain a second answer, e.g. $84.6°$, and no other in the interval. A1. Ignore answers outside the interval; accept AWRT $84.6$. Total: [4]
